This site publishes lab procedures. You can use it without an account, but many labs need a class code.

What is stored. With Google sign-in: your name and email. With a class code: a seat number, plus a label if your teacher adds one, and no name or email. For both: your lab entries and photos, Get help messages, Socratic 1 conversations, your color theme, and a record of your visits while signed in (pages opened, device type). Entries are stored so your work is safer than in your browser alone.

Who sees it. You and the site admins. Nothing is sold and no advertising is shown. Three services handle data for the site: Supabase hosts the database, Resend emails Get help messages to the admins, and Google Fonts supplies the fonts.

Socratic 1 (in beta; not yet available to Chem 10 accounts) is an AI chemistry review tool. Its replies come from an AI model made by Anthropic, so the server of this site sends Anthropic the text of each conversation. Nothing else is sent: no name, email, class code, seat or class. Do not type personal details into Socratic 1.

Deleting your data. While signed in, click the greeting at the top of the page and choose Delete my account. This permanently removes everything listed above except the visit record, which is no longer linked to you. A class code stops working. Backups are deleted after 30 days.
